## Packages

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(betareg)
library(maps)
library(sf)

```

## Data

```{r, analysis-data}

chna_data <- data %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("CHNA_", .x),
    starts_with("Priority")
  )

iplan_data <- data1 %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("IPLAN_", .x),
    starts_with("Priority")
  )

analysis_data <- full_join(
  chna_data,
  iplan_data,
  by = "County",
  suffix = c("_CHNA", "_IPLAN")
)


```

## Combine Data

```{r, combine-data}

chna_cols <- paste0("CHNA_Priority ", 1:5)
iplan_cols <- paste0("IPLAN_Priority ", 1:5)

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Shared_Priorities = length(intersect(
      unique(na.omit(c_across(all_of(chna_cols)))),
      unique(na.omit(c_across(all_of(iplan_cols))))
    )),

    Total_Distinct_Priorities = length(union(
      unique(na.omit(c_across(all_of(chna_cols)))),
      unique(na.omit(c_across(all_of(iplan_cols))))
    )),

    Priority_Overlap_Percent = if_else(
      Total_Distinct_Priorities > 0,
      (Shared_Priorities / Total_Distinct_Priorities) * 100,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r, descriptive-statistics}

summary(analysis_data$Priority_Overlap_Percent)

mean(analysis_data$Priority_Overlap_Percent, na.rm = TRUE)

sd(analysis_data$Priority_Overlap_Percent, na.rm = TRUE)

```
## CHNA vs. IPLAN Priorities

```{r, chna-iplan-plot}

# Hospital CHNA topic counts
chna_counts <- analysis_data %>%
  select(County, starts_with("CHNA_Priority")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("CHNA_Priority"),
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "") %>%
  distinct(County, Topic) %>%
  count(Topic, name = "CHNA_Count")

# County IPLAN topic counts
iplan_counts <- analysis_data %>%
  select(County, starts_with("IPLAN_Priority")) %>%
  distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("IPLAN_Priority"),
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "") %>%
  distinct(County, Topic) %>%
  count(Topic, name = "IPLAN_Count")

# Combine counts
topic_comparison <- full_join(
  chna_counts, iplan_counts, by = "Topic"
) %>%
  mutate(
    CHNA_Count = replace_na(CHNA_Count, 0L),
    IPLAN_Count = replace_na(IPLAN_Count, 0L)
  )

# Graph
chna_iplan_plot <- topic_comparison %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(CHNA_Count, IPLAN_Count),
    names_to = "Source",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Topic, Count),
             y = Count, fill = Source)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Hospital CHNA vs. County IPLAN Priorities",
    x = "Health Topic",
    y = "Number of Counties",
    fill = "Source"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

chna_iplan_plot 

```

## Save

```{r, save}

ggsave(
  filename = "graph/chna_iplan_plot.png",
  plot = chna_iplan_plot,

)
```

## Priority Overlap Odd Ratio

```{r, priorit-overlap}

# 2. Clean numeric columns (removing commas from Population and County Poverty)
analysis_data$Population_num <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", analysis_data$Population))
analysis_data$Poverty_num <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", analysis_data$`County Poverty`))

# 3. Define CHNA and IPLAN columns based on your naming convention
chna_cols <- paste0("CHNA_Priority ", 1:5)
iplan_cols <- paste0("IPLAN_Priority ", 1:5)

# If your actual columns are named differently (e.g., "Priority 1" through "Priority 5"), 
# make sure they match your data frame. Here is your exact snippet integrated:
overlap <- analysis_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Shared_Priorities = length(intersect(
      na.omit(c_across(all_of(chna_cols))),
      na.omit(c_across(all_of(iplan_cols)))
    )),
    Total_Distinct_Priorities = length(union(
      na.omit(c_across(all_of(chna_cols))),
      na.omit(c_across(all_of(iplan_cols)))
    )),
    Priority_Overlap_Percent = if_else(
      Total_Distinct_Priorities > 0,
      Shared_Priorities / Total_Distinct_Priorities * 100,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Create complete cases subset
vars_to_use <- c("Priority_Overlap_Percent", "Population_num", "Number of Hospitals with CHNAS", "Rurality", "Poverty_num")
analysis_clean <- analysis_data[complete.cases(analysis_data[, vars_to_use]), ]

# 5. Scale continuous predictors to fix numerical instability
analysis_clean$scaled_population <- scale(analysis_clean$Population_num)
analysis_clean$scaled_poverty <- scale(analysis_clean$Poverty_num)
analysis_clean$scaled_hospitals <- scale(analysis_clean$`Number of Hospitals with CHNAS`)

# 6. Transform percentage to strict 0-1 bounds for Beta regression
n <- nrow(analysis_clean)
analysis_clean$overlap_prop_adj <- (analysis_clean$Priority_Overlap_Percent / 100 * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

# 7. Fit Beta Regression model
model <- betareg(
  overlap_prop_adj ~ scaled_population + scaled_hospitals + Rurality + scaled_poverty,
  data = analysis_clean
)

summary(model)

# 8. Generate clean forest plot with constrained x-axis limits
coef_df <- data.frame(
  Predictor = c("County Population", "Number of Hospitals with CHNAS", "County Rurality", "County Poverty"),
  Estimate = exp(coef(model)[c("scaled_population", "scaled_hospitals", "Rurality", "scaled_poverty")]),
  Lower = exp(confint(model)[c("scaled_population", "scaled_hospitals", "Rurality", "scaled_poverty"), 1]),
  Upper = exp(confint(model)[c("scaled_population", "scaled_hospitals", "Rurality", "scaled_poverty"), 2])
)

priority_overlap_plot <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = Estimate, y = Predictor)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Factors Associated with County–Hospital Priority Overlap",
    subtitle = "Beta regression with 95% confidence intervals",
    x = "Odds Ratio / Effect Size (log scale)",
    y = "Predictor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

priority_overlap_plot

```

```{r, hospital-rurality}
chna_rurality_plot

```

```{r, chna-rurality-odds-ratio}

# 2. Subset complete cases for Rurality and Hospital Density
vars_to_use <- c("Rurality", "Number of Hospitals with CHNAS")
analysis_clean_subset <- analysis_data[complete.cases(analysis_data[, vars_to_use]), ]

# 3. Fit Poisson regression model (ideal for count outcomes like hospital count)
# This gives Rate Ratios / Odds-like effect sizes upon exponentiation
poisson_model <- glm(`Number of Hospitals with CHNAS` ~ Rurality, 
                     data = analysis_clean_subset, 
                     family = poisson(link = "log"))
summary(poisson_model)

# 4. Extract exponentiated coefficients (Incidence Rate Ratios) and 95% CIs
coef_df <- data.frame(
  Predictor = "County Rurality",
  Estimate = exp(coef(poisson_model)["Rurality"]),
  Lower = exp(confint(poisson_model)["Rurality", 1]),
  Upper = exp(confint(poisson_model)["Rurality", 2])
)

# 5. Generate forest plot in odds-ratio / rate-ratio format
chna_rurality_or_plot <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = Estimate, y = Predictor)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 1.5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of County Rurality on Hospital Density",
    subtitle = "Poisson regression Incidence Rate Ratio (log scale)",
    x = "Rate Ratio / Effect Size (95% CI)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

chna_rurality_or_plot

```

## Priorities: Behavioral and Mental Health and Chronic Disease Management

```{r, behavioral-chronic}

# ------------------------------------------
# 1. CREATE COUNTY IPLAN PRIORITY INDICATORS
# ------------------------------------------

county_long <- data1 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority"),
    names_to = "Priority_Number",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "")

county_indicators <- county_long %>%
  mutate(
    Behavioral = as.integer(str_detect(
      str_to_lower(Topic),
      "behavioral and mental health|behavioral health|mental health"
    )),
    Chronic = as.integer(str_detect(
      str_to_lower(Topic),
      "chronic disease management|chronic disease"
    ))
  ) %>%
  group_by(County) %>%
  summarise(
    County_Behavioral = max(Behavioral),
    County_Chronic = max(Chronic),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------
# 2. CREATE HOSPITAL CHNA PRIORITY INDICATORS
# ------------------------------------------
# Assumes chnaclean has County and Priority columns
# named Priority 1, Priority 2, etc.

hospital_long <- chnaclean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority"),
    names_to = "Priority_Number",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "")

hospital_indicators <- hospital_long %>%
  mutate(
    Behavioral = as.integer(str_detect(
      str_to_lower(Topic),
      "behavioral and mental health|behavioral health|mental health"
    )),
    Chronic = as.integer(str_detect(
      str_to_lower(Topic),
      "chronic disease management|chronic disease"
    ))
  ) %>%
  group_by(County) %>%
  summarise(
    Hospital_Behavioral = max(Behavioral),
    Hospital_Chronic = max(Chronic),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------
# 3. COMBINE DATA BY COUNTY
# ------------------------------------------

analysis_data <- county_indicators %>%
  full_join(hospital_indicators, by = "County") %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_data %>%
      select(
        County, Population,
        `Number of Hospitals with CHNAS`,
        Rurality, `County Poverty`
      ) %>%
      distinct(County, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "County"
  )

# Remove counties without known priority information
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(County_Behavioral),
    !is.na(Hospital_Behavioral),
    !is.na(County_Chronic),
    !is.na(Hospital_Chronic)
  )


# ------------------------------------------
# 4. BEHAVIORAL AND MENTAL HEALTH REGRESSION
# ------------------------------------------
# One model comparing county and hospital inclusion.
# Outcome: whether the county IPLAN includes the priority.
# Hospital inclusion is an explanatory variable.

behavioral_model <- glm(
  County_Behavioral ~ Hospital_Behavioral +
    Population + `Number of Hospitals with CHNAS` +
    Rurality + `County Poverty`,
  data = analysis_data,
  family = binomial
)

summary(behavioral_model)


# ------------------------------------------
# 5. CHRONIC DISEASE MANAGEMENT REGRESSION
# ------------------------------------------

chronic_model <- glm(
  County_Chronic ~ Hospital_Chronic +
    Population + `Number of Hospitals with CHNAS` +
    Rurality + `County Poverty`,
  data = analysis_data,
  family = binomial
)

summary(chronic_model)


# ------------------------------------------
# 6. GRAPH FUNCTION: ODDS RATIOS
# ------------------------------------------


make_or_plot <- function(model, graph_title) {

  results <- broom::tidy(model) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      OR = exp(estimate),
      Lower = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
      Upper = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
      Variable = dplyr::case_when(
        term %in% c("Hospital_Behavioral", "Hospital_Chronic") ~
          "Hospital CHNA includes priority",
        term == "Population" ~ "County population",
        term == "Number of Hospitals with CHNAS" ~
          "Number of hospitals with CHNAs",
        term == "Rurality" ~ "County rurality",
        term == "County Poverty" ~ "County poverty",
        TRUE ~ term
      )
    )

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    results,
    ggplot2::aes(x = OR, y = reorder(Variable, OR))
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = 1,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_log10() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = graph_title,
      x = "Odds Ratio (log scale)",
      y = "Predictor"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
}

# Graph 1
behavioral_plot <- make_or_plot(
  behavioral_model,
  "Factors Associated with Behavioral and Mental Health Priorities"
)

behavioral_plot

# Graph 2
chronic_plot <- make_or_plot(
  chronic_model,
  "Factors Associated with Chronic Disease Management Priorities"
)

chronic_plot

```

```{r, chna-poverty-odds-ratio}
# 1. Subset complete cases

]
```

## First Priority and County Poverty

```{r, one-priority-poverty}

poverty_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!is.na("CHNA_Priority 1"), !is.na(Poverty_num))

# Categorize poverty into low and high groups using the median
poverty_data <- poverty_data %>%
  mutate(
    Poverty_Group = ifelse(
      Poverty_num >= median(Poverty_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      "Higher Poverty",
      "Lower Poverty"
    )
  )

# Cross-tabulation
poverty_table <- table(
  poverty_data$`CHNA_Priority 1`,
  poverty_data$Poverty_Group
)

print(poverty_table)

# Chi-square test
chisq.test(poverty_table)

# Plot
priority_poverty_plot <- ggplot(poverty_data, aes(x = Poverty_Group, fill = `CHNA_Priority 1`)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "First CHNA Priority by County Poverty Level",
    x = "County Poverty Group",
    y = "Proportion of Counties",
    fill = "First CHNA Priority"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal()

priority_poverty_plot

```

## 1st Priority and Rurality

```{r, one-priority-rurality}

# 1. Remove missing values
rurality_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`CHNA_Priority 1`),
    !is.na(Rurality)
  )

# 2. Group rurality scores
rurality_data <- rurality_data %>%
  mutate(
    Rurality_Group = case_when(
      Rurality >= 1 & Rurality <= 3 ~ "Urban",
      Rurality >= 4 & Rurality <= 6 ~ "Suburban",
      Rurality >= 7 & Rurality <= 10 ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Rurality_Group = factor(
      Rurality_Group,
      levels = c("Urban", "Suburban", "Rural")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rurality_Group))

# 3. Cross-tabulation
rurality_table <- table(
  rurality_data$`CHNA_Priority 1`,
  rurality_data$Rurality_Group
)

print(rurality_table)

# 4. Chi-square test
chisq.test(rurality_table)

# 5. Plot
priority_rurality_plot <- ggplot(
  rurality_data,
  aes(x = Rurality_Group, fill = `CHNA_Priority 1`)
) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "First CHNA Priority by County Rurality",
    x = "County Rurality",
    y = "Proportion of Counties",
    fill = "First CHNA Priority"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal()

priority_rurality_plot

```
